scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Check the investment story
scenes.caption: Kabir receives a fictional app offer promising guaranteed daily returns. A familiar public figure appears to endorse it. The teacher has supplied a mock registry entry and company contact pack for comparison; these are not real regulatory records.
scenes.dialogue: Which exact claim does each source support?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A borrowed name and a release fee
scenes.caption: The offer uses a firm name and a copied-looking registration reference, but its app domain does not match the independently supplied contact. When withdrawal is requested, the sender demands another release fee. Neither an endorsement image nor a matching name verifies that request.
scenes.dialogue: A registry match is not a safety guarantee.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Verify the exact entity and channel
scenes.caption: Check the claimed entity, permitted role, contact route and offer against independent records. Even a verified registration would not promise returns or prove this sender controls that entity. Do not install an unverified app or pay a new fee to test a withdrawal claim.
scenes.dialogue: Verification reduces uncertainty; it does not remove investment risk.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the supported decision
scenes.caption: Should Kabir pay the release fee, trust the endorsement, or pause the offer and reject its unsupported payment instructions while checking through the independent route?
scenes.dialogue: A request for more money is not proof of recoverable funds.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A claim-source ledger
scenes.caption: Kabir records the mismatched channel, unverified endorsement and unsupported guaranteed return. He can explain the evidence for a pause without issuing investment advice or assuming a real organisation is fraudulent.
scenes.dialogue: The conclusion should be no broader than the evidence.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the verification lab
scenes.caption: Compare the synthetic source pack, classify each claim and choose a safe pause or rejection response. No real company, security or investment product is evaluated, and no recovery is promised.
scenes.dialogue: Check claims before money or documents move.
